noSite.message: No tracked site in this tab

emptyToday.message: Nothing counted yet. Time starts on the active tab while this window is in front.

focusHelp.message: A 25 min session follows a pomodoro rhythm. 50 min is a long session. Listed sites open on the block page until the timer ends.

reasonWhitelist.message: {host} is not on the allow list.

reasonFocus.message: Focus mode is running. {host} can wait.

snoozeHelp.message: Opens the site for five minutes. The daily allowance is set in the dashboard.

strictNoBypass.message: This session is strict. It ends on its own.

blockIdle.message: This page replaces a blocked site. Nothing is blocked right now.

trendFlat.message: Same time as the previous week

trendNew.message: No previous week to compare yet

noData.message: No time in this range yet. The counter runs on the active tab.

schedulesHelp.message: Blocks the listed sites in this window.

whitelistHelp.message: Sites excluded in settings stay open.

idleHelp.message: Below this, time is not counted.

excludedHelp.message: One domain per line, neither counted nor blocked.

badge.message: Show today’s time on the icon

incognitoHelp.message: Allow the extension in private windows to count those tabs.

passwordHelp.message: Unlocks a site until the day ends.

importFail.message: File refused. It needs a version 1 export.

importHint.message: Sections in the file replace current data.

resetConfirm.message: Erase all Unscroll data on this device?

vsPrev.message: Last seven days versus the previous week

noFocus.message: No session. Pick a length and the sites to set aside.

warnBody.message: {domain} is about to reach its limit.

focusStrictCode.message: A strict session does not stop early.

appDescription.message: Screen time per site, daily limits, blocking, and focus mode. Data stays on this device.

appDescriptionPro.message: Screen time, limits, advanced reports, and encrypted sync. Nothing is sent until you turn it on.

quote0.message: Time you give back to your attention stays yours.

quote1.message: A minute kept now is worth an hour later.

quote3.message: You had something else in mind. It is still possible.

quote4.message: A pause is a decision, not an absence.

quote5.message: This site will still be here. So will your evening.

quote6.message: Nothing urgent hides in one more scroll.

quote7.message: Coming back later is still moving forward.

quote8.message: Attention is not a junk drawer.

quote9.message: You can put the screen down and keep the thread.

proReportsHelp.message: Hours, categories, and focus sessions. The hourly detail starts with this edition. Categories apply to history already stored.

proSyncHelp.message: Off until you turn it on. Turning it on creates an anonymous account and a 32-byte key that stays on this device. You do not type a token or a passphrase. The server stores only ciphertext. The default server is https://sync.unscroll.elimbi.com. Change the address to use your own.

proCategoriesHelp.message: A domain includes its subdomains. The more specific domain wins. Uncategorized sites count as Other.

proNoHour.message: No hours for this day yet. The hourly detail fills in while you browse.

proNoCategory.message: No time across these seven days yet. Categories follow time already counted.

proEmptyCategories.message: No domain is classified. Add one to sort time already recorded.

proTokenSet.message: A token is already saved. Leave the field empty to keep it.

proTokenMissing.message: Leave empty to create an account. Eight characters minimum, no spaces, for an existing token.

proPassSet.message: A key or passphrase is already saved. Leave the field empty to keep it.

proPassMissing.message: For an older vault. Eight characters minimum. A new account does not use this field.

proErrConfig.message: An https or http URL. Leave the token empty to create an account, or enter a token and a key or passphrase that is already saved.

proErrDisabled.message: Turn sync on and save it before exchanging.

proErrEmpty.message: The server has no copy yet.

proErrConflict.message: Both copies changed. Push to keep this device, or pull to keep the server.

proErrHttp.message: The server answered in an unexpected way.

proErrPass.message: The key or passphrase cannot decrypt the server copy.

storageError.message: Local storage rejected the write. Try again. Nothing is sent.

storageReadError.message: Local storage could not be read. This screen starts from the default settings until the next try.

failed.message: The extension did not answer. Try again.

emptyLimits.message: No limit yet. Add a domain and the site blocks when today’s allowance runs out.

emptyBlock.message: No site is always blocked. Add a domain to cut it off right away.

emptyAllow.message: No site is allowed. In allow-list mode, only what you add here stays open.

emptySchedules.message: No schedule yet. Pick days and a clock range, and the listed sites block during those hours.

emptyHistory.message: No day recorded yet. History appears after the first counted minute.

meterLabel.message: Share of the allowance already used

proSyncHttps.message: HTTPS checks the certificate. The default server is https://sync.unscroll.elimbi.com. On this browser, http://127.0.0.1 is fine.

proSecretReady.message: A key or passphrase is already saved on this device.

proAdvancedHelp.message: For an existing vault, or a passphrase you already use. Leave blank to keep what is saved. A new account does not use these fields.

proClearSecret.message: Clear the saved key or passphrase

proProvisioned.message: Account created. Sync started. The key stays on this device.

proAccountSaved.message: The account is saved on this device. Sync did not finish.

proPairWarning.message: This QR code and this link grant full vault access (address, token and encryption key). Treat them like a password.

proQrTooBig.message: The QR code is too long. Copy the link.

proPasteHelp.message: The link saves the account and starts sync.

proPairInvalid.message: This pairing link cannot be read.

needSiteForFocus.message: Open a site, or set the session in Options.

billCanceling.message: Active until the end of the period

billKept.message: Your data stays on this device and can be exported. The server copy is kept for 30 days.
